title: FEC Advisory Opinion 2024-13: DSCC, Montanans for Tester, and Gallego for Arizona
text:
FEDERAL ELECTION COMMISSION
Washington, DC 20463
October 10, 2024
CERTIFIED MAIL
RETURN RECEIPT REQUESTED
Jacquelyn Lopez, Esq.
Jonathan Peterson, Esq.
Emma Anspach, Esq.
Elias Law Group
250 Massachusetts Ave NW, Suite 400
Washington, DC 20001
RE: Advisory Opinion Request 2024-13
Dear Ms. Lopez, Mr. Peterson, and Ms. Anspach:
This letter responds to your letter received on September 18, 2024, requesting an
advisory opinion on behalf of the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee (“DSCC”),
Montanans for Tester, and Gallego for Arizona. The purpose of this letter is to inform you that
the Commission has concluded its consideration of your advisory opinion request without issuing
an advisory opinion.
The Commission publicly released two draft advisory opinions and one revised draft
advisory opinion in response to your request. The drafts were identified as Agenda Document
Nos. 24-42-A and 24-42-B (released on October 3, 2024), and Agenda Document No. 24-42-B1
(released on October 4, 2024). These agenda documents are available on the Commission’s
website, at www.fec.gov.
At its Open Meeting of October 10, 2024, the Commission considered but did not
approve any of the draft advisory opinions. The Commission voted 3-3 on Agenda Document
Nos. 24-42-A and 24-42-B1. The affirmative vote of four members of the Commission is
required to render an advisory opinion under the Federal Election Campaign Act. See 52 U.S.C
§§ 30106(c), 30107(a)(7); see also 11 C.F.R. § 112.4(a). Thus, the Commission was unable to
render an opinion in this matter.

Jacquelyn Lopez, Esq.
Jonathan Peterson, Esq.
Emma Anspach, Esq.
October 10, 2024
Page 2
If you have any questions, please contact Joanna Waldstreicher or Luis Lipchak,
Attorneys, or Amy Rothstein, Assistant General Counsel, at 202/694-1650.
Sincerely,
Neven Stipanovic
Associate General Counsel
summary: Payment of costs for television advertisements. (Commission did not reach an agreement, so no AO was issued.)
